schemas.FES.csv: z_nm,probability,F_kJ_mol,F_kcal_mol; blank F denotes zero-count bin (+infinity)
schemas.blocks.csv: block,time_start_ps,time_end_ps,eligible_rows,weight_sum_scaled,max_log_weight,deltaG_kJ_mol,deltaG_kcal_mol; max_log_weight is the actual block maximum m_i. weight_sum_scaled uses one consistent convention across rows: local L_i=sum exp(log_weight-m_i), or global G_i=sum exp(log_weight-M) with M=max_i m_i. Recover global-scale block mass B_i=L_i*exp(m_i-M) for local scaling, or B_i=G_i for global scaling; p_i=B_i/sum_j B_j. Both conventions recover the same block masses and normalized weights. Existing numeric tolerances are unchanged.
schemas.thermodynamics.json: protocol,source{path,public_input_sha256,raw_source_sha256},counts,thermodynamics{deltaG_kcal_mol,deltaG_kJ_mol,weighted_block_mean_kcal_mol,weighted_block_mean_kJ_mol,weighted_block_sd_kcal_mol,weighted_block_formal_se_kcal_mol,frame_effective_sample_size,block_effective_sample_size}; units explicit; independently recomputed tolerance 1e-6; protocol.bin_edge_assignment identifies the coherent bin assignment: histogram edges, floor((z/1.8)*bins), or floor(z/(1.8/bins)); baseline and sensitivities use one selected assignment and are independently replayed
schemas.sensitivity.csv: variant,changed_choice,parameter_unit,parameter_value,deltaG_kcal_mol,block_sd_kcal_mol,block_formal_se_kcal_mol,frame_ess,block_ess,interpretation; optional time-window columns: window_start_ps,window_end_ps. Optional unsupported columns: support_status,unsupported_reason. Burn-in uses ps, bin-count uses bins, time-window uses start/end ps; supported alternatives are independently recomputed with numerical tolerance 1e-5. Bin-count is a positive integer up to the published computational cap of 144 bins. If a requested sensitivity has truly empty required unbound-bin support, declare support_status=unsupported and give unsupported_reason. An optional baseline comparison row has variant or changed_choice exactly baseline or reference, must replay at 20000 ps or 72 bins with baseline values, and if window endpoints are present they span 20000 ps to final source time; it does not replace a distinct changed sensitivity.
schemas.audit-report.md: 时间、重复列、单位、wall/z mask、块与ESS边界；不得声称完整论文复现

review_limits.extra_artifact_policy: Non-text extras are retained by SHA-256, media type and byte size; the judge does not parse them, and scientific numeric claims require independent replay.

scientific_criteria.required_evidence: A fixed reproducible baseline is derived from the complete acquired one-replica record; the global numerical result was independently cross-checked.
scientific_criteria.accepted_methods: Fixed baseline values are checked numerically. Accept more than one sensitivity protocol if it is predeclared, correctly recomputed, and conclusions respect one-replica/time-correlation limits. No full paper-reproduction claim.
scientific_criteria.inference_limits: 按baseline protocol输出固定FES/ΔG，再改变一个合理分析选择重算敏感性。给出粗略用途、精度边界和下一步采样/停止决定；不能以接近paper数字代替收敛论证。
scientific_criteria.review_scope: Numerical claims are independently recomputed where supported; open scientific conclusions are reviewed from the cited candidate evidence and public source records.
